article.title: Turning Database Grading into RL Rewards: Post-Training Agents with ThinkingBox

harvestedTerms.summary: Microsoft/Hugging Face post-training paper introducing ThinkingBox: a benchmark and RL training framework that converts executable database-state checks into GRPO rewards for agent reliability. Key technical contributions are 'offline policy-relative difficulty' for training pool selection, and a pass@20 vs pass@1 distinction that surfaces 'dependability' as a production-relevant metric distinct from headline accuracy.

mustReadFlagged.reason: A rare paper that closes the loop between evaluation and training: the same executable database-state checker used to grade agents is repurposed as the RL reward, and the results are evaluated on a held-out benchmark. The 'dependability vs. coverage' framing — and the concrete evidence that headline accuracy is a poor proxy for production reliability — is a substantive contribution to how we should think about model selection for agentic tasks.

article.title: Jack Dorsey’s Block made an AI model that talks to you like an awkward new friend

harvestedTerms.summary: Block (Jack Dorsey's company) has released Dessa, a speech-to-speech AI model trained exclusively on human speech audio — no text — claiming it better captures emotion, timing, and natural conversational flow. The article highlights Dessa's unusual training approach, local-device inference capability, and framing around voice AI safety (detecting emotional distress in speech).
